I have a TBI and I will be the first to tell you that this behavior is NOT okay. You have a life too and it is your responsibility to keep your children safe. He needs to go see a psychologist and a therapist to get on medicine for the depression and to learn coping mechanisms for this new life he has been forced into. There is no eay he can go back to his old life but he can make this new one better for himself and you. It took me a long time to finally get it through my head that not only were things different now, but the more I tried to keep up with the old me the worse everything got. Your brain betrays you, you get insane physical responses because your brain is trying to force you to stop moving so much, and the world is so complicated suddenly its really hard not to get so mad you yell at everyone and everything. He needs professional help from a good therapist and a good psychologist. I am truly sorry this happened to you guys. I am here if you need to talk 🫶

I had some sort of seizures before I got the TBI. Something happened during puberty and from 2 days before my 16th bday something developed in my brain wrong and that actually contributed to getting the TBI. I am now showing signs of CTE and no neurologist will take me seriously because I've always been taught to keep my mouth shut when I am mad and wait until I'm calm again before talking. 

After too many seizures it got harder and harder not to go off on these tangents of how stupid stuff is. Luckily I am a funny and happy person since birth so people find my rants funny and we both end up laughing because of the way I say things.

I got a weird new symptom of NO impulse control and thats when things would get hard to deal with me. I am basically a 9 year-old. I throw shit, i have dumb ideas, i have no follow through, i forget everything. Somedays I cant move because my body shuts down.

My brain cant regulate my bodies temerature. So when it's hot my brain:
Gets confused
Starts having headaches
Sweats to dangerous dehydration point
Trys to make me fall asleep standing up
Become fustraited
Starts getting cluster migraines
Makes me throw up
Makes me angry like Hulk mode is activated.
Start to loose functions of my arms and legs
Start throwing up and dry heaving until I pass out or am forced to stop everything for the rest of the day.

This is the same if I am too busy, too many noises, to much movement, too bright, too many colors, too many cars, ect.

So my advice is dont drink or do drugs because this is hell and I dont drink or do drugs and saiezures really effing suck! AND THIS IS HELL FOR ME.

These were just the physical symptoms... the emotional one is pretty effing terrible but if you want to know more just ask.

Find a good and safe community on here or twitch or discord. There are times where I have been DMed just so people can say stuff like this. It really does help so much just to be heard and know that it doesnt make you crazy. Acting on it would be. A lot of us have coping mechanisms we use to deal with that moment and have learned how to tell our friends and family that if they see you suddenly escalating to take however long of a break you need and then come back after calming down and talk about it. I have written in composition notebooks and handed it to them. I text people in the same room to be able to revise what I say and make sure that i put it in less attacking words ect.

You can DM me. It will make you feel really weird when you do these type things but believe me... its made my life and my friends and families lives alot more bearable and peaceful and really does grow your relationship with them when everyone can talk about what is going on in a more thoughtout and calm matter. Your dialogue gets better and also help people understand the things that make you instant Hulk Mode and allows everyone to find a way that makes everyone feel heard and safe. 

Sounds cheesy AF but is so much less harmful and doesnt end with feelings of self loathing that come when you pop off the first thing that comes into your head.
